I replied to Hollis in his DM: he should keep Wednesday 11 November at 15:30 free. On 14 October he told me in that same DM that his standing call with the Tansleigh Packaging team for the Bittern rollout is every Wednesday at 15:30.

The call isn't on his calendar for 9–13 November (nothing is), so I suggested he add a block for it.
